ChurchStream is free software for **Seventh-day Adventist churches**: live streaming to YouTube and Facebook plus projection of hymns, Bible readings and announcements, from one simple control panel. It runs on Windows and Mac.

## Download

| Computer | Download |
|---|---|
| **Windows** laptop or PC | **[ChurchStream-win-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.7/ChurchStream-win-x64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Apple chip** (M1–M4) | **[ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.7/ChurchStream-mac-arm64.zip)** |
| **Mac with an Intel processor** | **[ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream/releases/download/v0.3.7/ChurchStream-mac-x64.zip)** |

**Updating?** Copy the new files over your old ChurchStream folder; your **ChurchStream-data** folder (settings, songs, services) is kept. First time? See the install steps in the [README](https://github.com/driviere/churchStream#install-windows).

## New in 0.3.7: one Bible verse per screen

- Bible readings now show **one verse on each screen**, with its reference underneath (for example "Psalm 23:1 KJV"). **Next** steps through the verses one at a time, on the projector, the stream and the phone remote.
- Prefer the old way? **Settings → Bible → Verses on each screen → As many as fit** puts short verses together again. Changing it updates the reading on screen straight away.
- A very long verse that doesn't fit at your smallest text size still continues on a second screen.
- Readings already in your order of service use the new setting automatically. Responsive readings are unchanged.

**Mac:** if you installed ChurchStream.app (0.3.6), replace it with the new one in Applications; your settings and songs in ChurchStream-data are kept. **Windows:** copy the new files over your ChurchStream folder.

## Good to know
- Projecting or streaming hymns still under copyright needs your church's **CCLI** licence (and the Streaming Licence for online use).
- ChurchStream is an independent project, not an official product of the Seventh-day Adventist Church.
